    -- Bottom face edges (z=0)
    (m_ab : a ⟶ b) (m_ac : a ⟶ c) (m_bd : b ⟶ d) (m_cd : c ⟶ d)
    -- Top face edges (z=1)
    (m_ef : e ⟶ f) (m_eg : e ⟶ g) (m_fh : f ⟶ h) (m_gh : g ⟶ h)
    -- Vertical edges
    (m_ae : a ⟶ e) (m_bf : b ⟶ f) (m_cg : c ⟶ g) (m_dh : d ⟶ h)
    -- Five square faces commute (e.g., all except top)
    (h_bottom : m_ab ≫ m_bd = m_ac ≫ m_cd)
    (h_front : m_ab ≫ m_bf = m_ae ≫ m_ef)
    (h_left : m_ac ≫ m_cg = m_ae ≫ m_eg)
    (h_back : m_cd ≫ m_dh = m_cg ≫ m_gh)
    (h_right : m_bd ≫ m_dh = m_bf ≫ m_fh)
    -- One edge into target of the sixth (top) face is epi
    (h_epi : CategoryTheory.Epi m_gh)
